page.overview:
Who is Aelfric Cyenwulf?

Aelfric Cyenwulf, High Zar of the Kurgan tribe known as the Iron Wolves, is a Champion of Chaos and one of the lieutenants of Archaon, the thirteenth Everchosen. Though no sorcerer, Aelfric was a servant of Tchar, known as Tzeentch, the Chaos God of change and intrigue, in the south.

Cyenwulf gathered a great Chaos horde and launched an invasion of Kislev in the days just before the Storm of Chaos campaign that ultimately resulted in his death at the hands of a joint Kislevite and Imperial army.

By the year 2522 IC, Cyenwulf had nearly forty-thousand warriors under his banner, with more arriving by the day, their ragged skull totems as high as their ululating warcries. Victory bred victory, and the tribes of the north -- the Kul, Hung, Vargs as well as Kyazak raiders -- all flocked to him, eager to share in his success. Individual warbands of fearsome Chaos Champions came, too, Men and monsters alike. Eight hand-picked Chaos Warriors accompanied him at all times, over which he towered.

With an army of forty thousand, including Chaos Hounds, Trolls, Warriors of Chaos, and a Dragon Ogre, Cyenwulf made for Urszebya to corrupt the heart of Kislev to the worship of the Dark Gods. His horde would be countered by a joint force of twenty-five thousand troops, comprised of Tilean mercenaries under General Albertalli, General Clemenz Spitzaner's army from Talabecland and General Kaspar von Velten's army from Stirland; as well as the Tzarina Katarin Bokha's personal pulk.
